newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Brau u. Brunnen may end 1996 with loss.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Brau u. Brunnen may end 1996 with loss.

text.p: German brewery Brau und Brunnen AG said on Tuesday it could not rule out ending 1996 with a loss even after the company took several extraordinary measures to generate earnings.
"A dividend is therefore not to be considered," said management board member Friedrich Ebeling in a mandatory statement.
Germany's Brau u. Brunnen may end 1996 at loss
The brewer said it had sold during the first nine months of the year 12 million hectolitres of beverages, nearly eight percent less than in the year-ago period.

Sales were down 7.9 percent to 1.5 billion marks ($994.2 million) , while on a comparable basis excluding the sale of its Coca Cola concession and the Schwarzwald mineral water business, sales were down 5.6 percent.
Brau und Brunnen said its beer sales were down 2.9 percent during the first three quarters of the year, mirroring wider industry conditions. ($ = 1.508 German Marks)
